result.reasoning: This commit replaced the `@Configuration` annotation with `@EnableWebSecurity` on SecurityConfig, which caused Spring Security to intercept static resource requests (like JS files) and serve them with incorrect MIME types (as HTML instead of JS), triggering the "Refused to execute script... because its MIME type ('text/html') is not executable" error. The commit's own message explicitly says it "introduce[s] error". The fix commit reverts this exact change back to `@Configuration`, directly undoing this BIC.
